propositions: merge.ours.driver is set per-clone in init.py but never committed, so reconcile-bridge.yml runner lacks the config and git silently falls back to 3-way text merge of large JSON files instead of local-wins behaviour
reconcile-bridge.yml performs bare git worktree add without calling rebar init, unlike reconcile-bridge-canary.yml which calls rebar init and thus obtains merge.ours.driver via _merge_ours_unit
undefined merge=ours driver on the runner causes reconverge path to lazily fault large blobs mid-merge when blob:none filtering keeps commits but removes merge-base blobs
reconcile-bridge.yml must set merge.ours.driver=true for the tickets worktree before any merge step as a prerequisite for CI clone filter (B1)
reconcile-bridge-canary.yml should be asserted to obtain the driver via existing rebar init call with no edits, as a regression guard
